key_insight: Design guidelines for high-performance diamond-based solar cells and diodes focus on optimizing defect structures for enhanced optoelectronic performance.
engineering_relevance: These guidelines serve as a foundation for the practical fabrication of efficient diamond-based photovoltaic devices and single-dopant diodes.
method: First-principles investigation of PIN and PN junctions using defects.
Use of density functional theory with GW corrections and Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations.
Carrier transport modeling coupled with electrostatics via a Poisson solver.
evidence_signal: The BVB defect creates intermediate bands without degrading diamond's high carrier mobility or thermal conductivity.
watch_item: Careful consideration is needed regarding the impact of defects on material properties in practical applications.
paper_title: From Defects to Devices: Design Guidelines for High-Performance Diamond-Based Solar Cells and Single-Dopant Diodes
